description: Defines the HTMLPurifier_URI class which models and validates URIs within the HTML Purifier library, including methods for normalization, validation, and string conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URI
classes.description: Represents and manages the validation and serialization of URIs in the HTML Purifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a URI object with components, normalizing scheme and port.

methods.name: getSchemeObj
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme object associated with the URI's scheme, or the default scheme if none is set.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and encodes URI components according to RFC 3986 rules.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Reconstructs the URI string from its components.

methods.name: isLocal
methods.description: Determines if the URI is considered local based on host matching.

methods.name: isBenign
methods.description: Checks if the URI is local and has a secure scheme, indicating it is safe.
